body: The `_should_display_update_spinner()` call appears to do some relevant stuff. Wouldn't it make more sense to change the first check to `if (update_spinner->is_visible() and __should_display_update_spinner())`?

Nevermind, the visibility of the spinner is decided by this method. But then the method itself is not needed, it's only used in one place and anywhere else it may be needed, you can check visibility instead.
